name: Quant retention figures come from Hugging Face model cards, not from records, and most derivative bases are not tracked models
symptom: data/quant_retention.jsonl holds 144 base-vs-quant comparisons taken from derivative repo cards. Only 7 of the 144 resolve to a model record in this repo; the other 137 name bases such as IFM/K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B that have no record. No docs/ page may cite these deltas as record-backed facts.
root_cause: The derivative layer was built by querying the Hugging Face Hub API with a base_model filter (data/derivatives.jsonl, 13624 repos), then reading each card's own comparison table. The cards are the source; this repo's model records are a separate, much smaller set that was never extended to cover the long tail of base models those derivatives point at.
workaround: Treat data/quant_retention.jsonl as a derivative-sourced index, not a record. Quote a retention figure only with the derivative repo id and the card's own reference column; cite [[models/x]] only where base_model is non-null. Promote a base to a model record before any figure about it appears in docs/.
notes: Roughly 37% of the 461 low-bit repos that claim a delta name a base reference at all (172 of 461); the other 63% compare quants to each other or publish nothing. Retention is recomputed from raw base/quant cells with metric direction applied because agent-read cards flipped PPL signs and swapped columns inconsistently; 18 rows still show an impossible gain and are bucketed 'suspect' rather than ranked.
